rules: An authoritative quest, character, item, cleanup key, lifecycle reason, and target quantity are required.
Cleanup reduces only matching character-owned quest quantities above the explicit target.
Removal order is deterministic by descending runtime instance ID so earlier identities are retained.
Partial stack reduction preserves the source instance identity.
Explicit quest_cleanup_protected metadata blocks cleanup and rolls back the complete mutation.
Cleanup never infers completion, abandon, failure, or reset triggers from item names or quest labels.
assumptions: Quest orchestration supplies the lifecycle reason and target quantity from authoritative quest behavior.
Stable deterministic ordering is Reforged compatibility infrastructure until native removal ordering is recovered.
safe_fallback: No cleanup occurs without explicit authoritative inputs; protected or structurally invalid items fail atomically.
runtime_impact: Enables exact quest completion, abandon, failure, and reset cleanup orchestration without duplicate or orphaned quest quantities.
character_save_impact: Persisted quest item quantities and runtime identities are updated atomically.
world_state_impact: None; only character-owned inventory, equipment, portable-container, and bank state is eligible.
